title: Perfect way to use odd balances on prepaid cards
text: I often use Amazon's Gift Card Balance Reload to finish the remaining balances on any prepaid debit cards I have. Those cards come from many sources these days, such as rebates, promotional offers, and sometimes even government payments. It can be difficult to use up a card's entire balance through random online/retail purchases, so I'm very thankful that Amazon allows reloading of an exact value down to the cent - no more throwing away cards that still have a small amount left. There's always something great to buy on Amazon, so these balance reloads never go to waste. Five stars.

title: Amazon.com gift card delivered but never received (stolen?)
text:
U.S.P.S delivery tracking claims that my gift card was delivered, but I never got it. This appears to be the first item ever stolen from my mailbox in 7 1/2 years. I suspect that Amazon puts "Amazon.com" as the return address, thereby alerting EVERYONE that it contains a gift card, which of couse ANYONE can use.

The upshot is that I'm out the $25.00 I paid to Amazon, and Amazon provides no way for me to even inform them that the gift card was stolen/lost.
My recommendation: Don't buy Amazon gift cards. They are sitting ducks.
Instead, give a check or some other type of gift card for that you buy in person.
